title: A Multitask, Multilingual, Multimodal Evaluation of ChatGPT on Reasoning, Hallucination, and Interactivity

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing model performance on natural language processing tasks (Sentiment Analysis, Language Identification, and Machine Translation) across a diverse set of languages categorized by their resource availability (high, medium, low, and extremely low-resource languages) and script types (Latin vs. non-Latin) to identify performance disparities and inclusivity concerns.
